title: Integrate export history into ExportDialog
action: Wire useExportHistory into ExportDialog — record each export event and display recent history below the format selector.
implementation: Import useExportHistory in ExportDialog. Call recordExport(format, title, wordCount) inside handleExport after the export call. Use existing i18n pattern for new strings (exportHistoryTitle, exportHistoryEmpty, exportHistoryFormat). Update ExportDialog.test.tsx to verify recording.
